original: Disinfect or boil water before drinking.
english: Disinfect or boil water before drinking.
portuguese: Desinfete ou ferva a agua antes de beber.

original: Use roads, the coast, and mapped landmarks to hold your bearing.
english: Use roads, the coast, and mapped landmarks to hold your bearing.
portuguese: Use estradas, a costa e marcos mapeados para manter sua orientacao.

original: Aeroporto de Noronha is one of the island's marked landmarks.
english: Aeroporto de Noronha is one of the island's marked landmarks.
portuguese: O Aeroporto de Noronha e um dos marcos mapeados da ilha.

original: Carry bandages; stopping bleeding early is safer than treating blood loss later.
english: Carry bandages; stopping bleeding early is safer than treating blood loss later.
portuguese: Carregue bandagens; parar o sangramento cedo e mais seguro do que tratar a perda de sangue depois.

original: The Noronha world is 10.24 km by 10.24 km. Plan long crossings before nightfall.
english: The Noronha world is 10.24 km by 10.24 km. Plan long crossings before nightfall.
portuguese: O mundo de Noronha tem 10,24 km por 10,24 km. Planeje travessias longas antes do anoitecer.

original: Rain and cold demand dry clothes and a fire.
english: Rain and cold demand dry clothes and a fire.
portuguese: Chuva e frio exigem roupas secas e uma fogueira.

original: Before crossing open ground, decide where your next cover is.
english: Before crossing open ground, decide where your next cover is.
portuguese: Antes de cruzar terreno aberto, decida onde esta sua proxima cobertura.

original: A full stomach and dry clothes buy more time than a rushed fight.
english: A full stomach and dry clothes buy more time than a rushed fight.
portuguese: Um estomago cheio e roupas secas compram mais tempo do que uma luta apressada.
